pages.text: The Network Receiver is used to receive signals from a Network Transmitter, allowing you to create long-distance wireless networks.

To use the Network Receiver:$(li)Place it within range of your Controller$(li)Connect it to your network using cables$(li)Insert a Network Card to configure the receiving channel$(li)Ensure the channel matches the Network Transmitter's channel

The Network Receiver can be used to extend your network over long distances by receiving signals from a Network Transmitter. This allows you to create separate network segments that can communicate with each other.
